liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **They Love Each Other** (4 reviews): They Love Each Other is named among the show's standout performances; They Love Each Other is judged equally smoking [9][11][16][17]
- **Row Jimmy** (3 reviews): Row Jimmy is described as the very first performance ever; Row Jimmy is cited as one of several songs first played here that stayed in the repertoire [12][15][16]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): China Cat into I Know You Rider is singled out as great; China Cat into Rider is called possibly the most smoking version the reviewer has heard [9][11][13]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes Of The World is called a sweet version [13]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River is singled out as especially great, with Jerry and Bobby sounding right on [10]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Sugar Magnolia is praised as a tasty early version [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Wavy Gravy chatter**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Dead battery**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Row Jimmy, Loose Lucy, Beer Barrel Polka, Here Comes Sunshine, They Love Each Other, Eyes Of The World, China Doll, Wave That Flag [21]

## The recordings

- **gd73-02-09.sbd.bertha-fink.14939.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 198 min; rated 4.76/5 by 63 [1]. Said about its sound: The original source is rough for a soundboard, but this remix sounds excellent [12]
- **gd1973-02-09.sbd.ashley.12571.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 196 min; rated 4.64/5 by 33 [5]. Said about its sound: Casey Jones has a lot of distortion [5]
- **gd1973-02-09.sbd.finney.10361.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 196 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Casey Jones has a lot of distortion [6]
- **gd1973-02-09.150166.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 30 songs; 207 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [7]
- **gd73-02-09.sbd.allred.9888.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 194 min; rated 4.51/5 by 66 [8]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds fantastic, with Jerry's guitar very high in the mix; The drum mix is excellent, with the bass drum's boom driving the whole show [16][20]

## Around the show

- Major technical problems plagued the show, which the reviewer calls the band's first show back [15]
- Many technical failures occurred; all tweeters were lost on the first note of Promised Land [5]
- Many technical failures occurred; all tweeters were lost on the first note of Promised Land [6]
- Reviewer says many of these songs were being played for the first time in this show [9]
- Unlike many shows from the period, it has no long, winding jams like Dark Star, The Other One or Caution [13]
- Reviewer sees it as a greatest-hits style show, like others played from 1971 through 1973, without long jams [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-02-09.sbd.bertha-fink.14939.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Jay Ashley (Bertha) remaster of an earlier MR source [1]
- **gd1973-02-09.sbd.ashley.12571.shnf**: transferred by Bertha Remaster by; source: SBD>>MR>>REEL>>DAT>>SS>>CDR>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA [5]. Also: Remastered by an archive.org user in September 2002 on a dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha, from an MR 2-track reel through Dolby B reel and DAT [5]
- **gd1973-02-09.sbd.finney.10361.shnf**: transferred by Popi; source: MR 2 Track Reel > 7.5 IPS 1/4 tack dolby B reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR [6]. Also: This is another EAC extraction from the same original Finney seed disc [6]
- **gd1973-02-09.150166.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 19, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (44.1k) [7]. Also: This source runs about ten minutes longer than other sources, noted at Eyes Of The World; Pitch correction settings were supplied by Joe B. Jones [7]
- **gd73-02-09.sbd.allred.9888.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Mason's Children: [February Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/february-grateful-dead-show-listening-guides) [22]
- Fan art by @admin: [Grateful Dead X Stanford University X Class Trip Live At Stanford Maples Pavilion On February 9 1973 T-Shirts, hoodie, l](https://theteestudios.com/product/grateful-dead-x-stanford-university-x-class-trip-live-at-stanford-maples-pavilion-on-february-9-1973-t-shirts/) [23]
